concerns.text: Task T018 mandates generating 3D descriptors from 'gas-phase minimized conformations' to avoid data leakage. This directly contradicts FR-004 and FR-012 which explicitly require descriptors to be 'derived from the CIF coordinates' (experimental data). This is a semantic weakening of the spec's requirement to model the relationship between topology and experimental packing, replacing it with a topology-to-gas-phase-geometry relationship.

Task T015 describes calculating CAPE as the 'target' and PC_raw as 'diagnostic only'. However, the Plan summary and FR-003/FR-011 context indicate PC_raw is the standard metric while CAPE is a normalization covariate. The task description creates ambiguity on the regression target, risking the training of a model on a derived metric (CAPE) when the spec (FR-005) and plan imply PC_raw is the primary target for topology prediction.

Tasks T027 and T029 use the placeholder '[deferred]' for the permutation test shuffle count. FR-016 explicitly mandates '10,000 shuffles' as a non-negotiable requirement for p-value resolution. Using a placeholder for a fixed, hard-coded requirement violates the constraint preservation principle.

Phase 6 (T040-T045) introduces extensive new features (conformational ensembles, H-bonding capacity, planarity metrics, rule-based baselines, diffraction cross-validation) and experimental steps that are not authorized by any Functional Requirement (FR-001 to FR-019) in the spec. This constitutes scope creep and a violation of the constraint that tasks must not silently relax or expand the spec's defined scope without explicit authorization.

Task T018 describes re-loading CIFs to generate gas-phase conformers but fails to explicitly mandate that the resulting feature matrix retains the COD ID provenance tag required by Constitution Principle VI ('Open Crystallographic Data Integrity'). Without this explicit instruction, the task risks breaking the 'Single Source of Truth' chain for the derived 3D descriptors.
